title: Looking for free resource s for a Dark fantasy/vampire/steampunk project

posts.author: Andyspt
posts.body:
Hey fellas, me and a friend decided to start a project for our just entertainment based on some Vanhelsing/vampiric theme and i would like to know some resources of this kind out there. We will credit everything we use on our project.
We also dont mind to add more people onto our project which we will be posting our idea soon.
we are really thankfull and will appreciate any help given.
Cheers to all the Makers, and lets make the gaming world a better a world =)

posts.author: TeiRaven
posts.body:
The first thing we need to know is what engine you're using and what engines you own! If I point you in the direction of XP resources, but you only own MZ, I won't be of any help to you at all XD
Also very important is what style you want these in! Do you want it to be something that matches the RTP of the engine you're using, or are you looking for a different style? That will change your options and/or the amount of editing you'll have to do to make everything cohesive.
Searching Resource Central for "Halloween," "Steampunk," and "Victorian" will get you a great start. In the search options, select "This Category" and it will only search that forum section. With long enough words, it works a treat.
If you have VX/A and/or XP,
Pandamaru
has some great Halloween things that may include some of the vampire-relevant items you're looking for. Lunarea used to have a whole selection of VXA steampunk resources, but I think they've fallen victim to the Photobucket watermark curse. There's also the
ReStaffs
, which are collections of resources often around a theme, and there are definitely some Halloween ones that might have some of the things you'd need.
Hope that gets you started!

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
I don't want to discourage you, but with such a broad and vague request it is nearly impossible to help you. If you want to make a game without the default resources, that means you will spend a long time gathering and sorting what is there, start making your game and then you can slowly think about asking clear questions.
Your first step now is to check every thread in
RPG Maker MZ resources
.
If you own RPG Maker MV (which I'd recommend), you can more than double what is available for you by checking the
MV section
, too.
In
General resources
there are also some things that you will want to use.
The thing is - only you know what you need. So you need to build your base and then ask very clear questions. Like "I need an animated coffin for a game made in RMMZ, I own these makers, [insert all the parameters important for that one resource]".
This huge search might be fun - or not at all, all the saving, organising, keeping track of the terms of use... but that is the base for your game. You can be inspired by what is there, you can see what is possible and what might not be easy to do due to lack of resources.
For example, there are
pretty neat vampires
, and you would have easily found them if you looked around a little before you started this request ;3
Some general tips:
Keep the scope of your first game small, rather be able to finish something than to get overwhelmed and frustrated.
The forum can help you a lot, but you need to do the heavy lifting for your project yourself. It is very unlikely to get an artist on board (ask me, the artist, how I know ;D), especially if you have nothing yet to show.
Every beginning is difficult, but the program comes with a documentation and there are tons of tutorials here. It also helps to check other threads to learn what information you need to give to get proper answers. For example, there is a
pinned request template
which you completly ignored ;D
